BEFORE YOU SIGN UP

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Is the trial really free?+

The bootcamp offer advertises no subscription charge for 30 days. Communication usage can still cost extra. The selected subscription rebills monthly after the trial unless cancelled. Read the current checkout terms before committing.

Which plan will I be on?+

Confirm the selected plan and renewal amount on HighLevel’s checkout. This page does not promise a particular paid tier or that all add-ons are included.

Will I need a payment card?+

Expect card details at signup. If you are not comfortable with an automatically renewing trial, review the provider’s terms before registering.

Can I cancel?+

HighLevel’s offer says you can cancel anytime. Cancel before the trial ends to avoid the next subscription charge. Usage charges may still apply.

When is it, and is there a recording?+

The main offer lists weekdays at 11am US Central, but some FAQ wording differs. Confirm your session by email. The published format is live, about an hour, and not recorded.

Can I attend on my phone?+

Use a laptop or desktop so you can follow the setup steps.

Is BrigePoint part of HighLevel?+

No. BrigePoint is independent. HighLevel runs the training, provides the software, and manages its billing and support. I may receive a referral commission.
